acnh.intro: Rosie is a peppy cat villager in the who appears in all games to date as well as in, where she is a major character and is one of Ai's best friends.
acnh.appearance: Rosie is cerulean blue with darker blue hair and fur, big pie-eyed symbols angled as if glancing off to the right — cross when angry or sad, pointed in opposite directions when moods shift. Pink blush warms her cheeks; white tips her paws, tail, feet, and ears while inner ears fade pink to light pink. No nose shows, yet her curly smile carries all the expression she needs, hence the rosy name.
acnh.personality: Rosie shines peppy-bright — gifts, compliments, quick forgiveness, and moods that flip fast over tiny slights before she forgets them. Snooty and cranky gossip stings; she may feel insulted when style or tone turns sharp. Lazy neighbors can feel mismatched while jocks get her cheer in return, the male mirror to her energy. Normal, big sister, and smug villagers round out her easy friendships with warmth she hands out freely. Show up with kindness and she becomes one of the villagers who makes the plaza feel like a daily celebration, rewarding friends with praise and little surprises.
